text:
Maya R.: heads up — saw two customer tickets today where mixed-dim embeds were rejected by the fastpath splitter and the SDK only surfaced a bare `413 Payload Too Large`. No hint, no actionable next step, lots of support churn.
Jessica L.: ugh. can we include a structured error body on rejects with a clear hint field? e.g. `HTTP/1.1 413` + body: ```{
  "code": "embed_oversize",
  "reason": "mixed_dims_or_bytes",
  "hint": "try /v1/embeddings/preflight to get split plan or set X-Embed-FastFail: false"
}```
Arun P.: routing/runtime note — currently we try fallback to slowpath when the splitter can produce variants. but if the client fast-fails we return 413 immediately. two levers: make fallback default for non-enterprise customers OR change SDK to automatically call preflight.
Ryan H.: sdk approach is fastest. we can detect 413 + `embed_oversize` and call `POST /v1/embeddings/preflight` then retry with the split parts. i'll prototype py/ts today. also add a `retry_after_split` metric.
Sam K.: console UX: we should surface a one-click suggestion on the route page when recent 413s spike: show recommended split size, sample curl, and a link to open the preflight modal. small panel like "Fix 413s" that expands.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started: `embed-splitter:v2` -> us-west-2 (20% nodes).
Jessica L.: if we add structured errors we must version them and document in the API changelog. propose `error.hint_type` values: `preflight`, `dimension_hint`, `bytes_hint`. also include `expected_dims` array when available.
Arun P.: plumbing: runtime can attach `x-embed-splitter-reason` header for quick parsing by proxies/clients. sample header: `x-embed-splitter-reason: mixed-dims;preferred_split=1536`
Ryan H.: example client flow I'm thinking: ```http
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
X-Embed-Client-Hint: dims=4096,batch=20
{ "input": [...] }
```
if 413 + `embed_oversize` -> call `POST /v1/embeddings/preflight` with same body headers -> server returns a split plan -> client resends chunked requests. I'll add an opt-in `X-Embed-AutoSplit: true` header so we don't surprise legacy users.
Maya R.: love that. timeline: Ryan — SDK PR + tests this week. Jessica + Arun — spec + example error bodies + header names. Sam — console panel mock by EOD Friday. I'll open a tiny incident/ops runbook for support.
Sam K.: can you add a Grafana query suggestion? I want a time series: `sum(rate(embed_requests_total{status=\"413\"}[5m])) by (route)` and a ratio panel: `413 / total_requests` with drilldown to `embed.preflight.hit` metric.
Ryan H.: on it. i'll also emit `embed.fastpath.reject_reason` tag (values: `mixed_dims`, `bytes`, `unparsable`) so we can break down.
Jessica L.: one more: include an example `preflight` request/response in the docs so SDKs can mirror behavior. sample preflight response: ```json
{ "plan": [ { "start": 0, "end": 10, "dims": 1536 }, { "start": 10, "end": 20, "dims": 512 } ], "estimated_tokens": 12345 }
```
Arun P.: note: splitter v2 already returns `preferred_split` in traces. we just need to ensure it's surfaced in structured error/headers and that telemetry emits a boolean `preflight_offered`.
Maya R.: ok team — sync tomorrow 11am to close the PRs and wire the dashboard. tagging this thread for support handoff and docs owners. thanks! :thumbsup:
